svg.aria-label: Seqora, my main project since July 2026: a desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and SQL Server, built alone with Rust, Svelte and Tauri for macOS and Windows. It answers four questions: which connection am I on, will this change data, what just ran, and how does this table relate to that one.
